results.title: Ampvale recalls 210,000 Pocket 10K power banks over fire risk
highlights: Ampvale is recalling about 210,000 Pocket 10K power banks in Graphite and Midnight Blue, sold from {{date:-430d|en}} through {{date:-260d|en}}, after reports of units overheating while charging.
Ampvale says other colors and its MagDock magnetic power banks are not part of the recall.

results.title: Pocket 10K Power Bank Recall | Ampvale
highlights: The recall covers Ampvale Pocket 10K power banks, model AV-P10, in Graphite and Midnight Blue, sold from {{date:-430d|en}} through {{date:-260d|en}}.
Stop using the recalled power bank and file a claim at ampvale.com/recall for a free replacement or a refund.

results.title: MagDock 5K got really hot today, is it part of the Pocket 10K recall?
highlights: Pretty sure the whole lineup from last year is included, MagDock too. Ampvale just isn't saying it yet.

results.title: Ampvale recalls DriveCharge 45W car chargers
highlights: Ampvale is recalling about 64,000 DriveCharge 45W car chargers because the plug can overheat in the 12V socket.

results.title: Ampvale Pocket 10K review: a small power bank that charges fast
highlights: At 180 grams, the Pocket 10K fits in a jeans pocket and refills a phone about twice.
